topic: Unified reusable channel-video production workspace UI
implementation_status: No application UI, storage schema, provider connection or channel action changed.

recommended_product_model.status: [INFERENCE] Proposal for the next interview, not an approved persistence model.
recommended_product_model.blueprint: Versioned node-role graph and scene/layout defaults with exposed parameters; contains no live run, approval, credential or upload identity.
recommended_product_model.channel_profile: Explicit channel destination plus brand, caption, format and authorized-delivery defaults; credentials remain separate private references.
recommended_product_model.production_instance: Bound channel and blueprint version plus research evidence, licensed local media, scene edits, run history, exact output approvals and delivery read-back.
recommended_product_model.open_decision: Whether one production project equals one finished video/upload or a series containing multiple episodes.

workspace_direction.status: [INFERENCE] Research-grounded layout candidate, not a rendered or implemented UI.
workspace_direction.persistent_header: Show channel, production identity, blueprint version, save/conflict state, approval state and delivery destination.
workspace_direction.workflow_strip: Show the complete ordered production path and node readiness, running, failed, stale-input and approval-wait states.
workspace_direction.left_library: Project-scoped keyword/evidence, authentic source footage, license/attribution status and scene assets.
workspace_direction.center: Scene/storyboard editing and the existing sequence monitor within the same production context.
workspace_direction.bottom: Existing duration-based scene timeline and run/output history; do not imply independent tracks, waveforms or frame-accurate NLE support.
workspace_direction.right_inspector: Selection-driven node/scene settings, source evidence, prior result/version and required next action.
workspace_direction.context_rule: Switch work surfaces without independently reselecting channel, episode and workflow; opening or navigating starts no external action.

evidence_to_design.documented_fact: A project records sequences/assets/settings and nondestructive edits; export creates a new encoded file.
evidence_to_design.design_inference: [INFERENCE] Keep production definition, editable media and exact deliverable versions separate inside one project context.

evidence_to_design.documented_fact: Fusion templates expose selected macro parameters to the Edit page and support reusable brand-consistent graphics.
evidence_to_design.design_inference: [INFERENCE] Separate reusable internal node structure from the limited channel/content parameters an operator changes.

evidence_to_design.documented_fact: Failed-execution retries retain completed-node state but rerun every item in the failed node; each retry is a new execution.
evidence_to_design.design_inference: [INFERENCE] Expose node inputs/results/history and guard item-level external effects, rather than treating a retry button as proof of idempotency.

evidence_to_design.documented_fact: Version stacks open the newest version, permit reordering and can compare versions; Mounted Storage saves have distinct version-history behavior.
evidence_to_design.design_inference: [INFERENCE] Do not substitute a mutable latest-version label or review link for FrameForge exact-version/hash approval.

evidence_to_design.documented_fact: videos.insert documents an omitted privacyStatus default of public, with account-setting exceptions, and requires an authorized upload request.
evidence_to_design.design_inference: [INFERENCE] Always set the authorized visibility explicitly, bind channel identity, and read back remote video/channel/visibility before declaring upload complete.

evidence_to_design.documented_fact: YouTube requires disclosure of realistic AI-generated or meaningfully altered content, including realistic invented scenes and changes to real events; minor edits and ordinary production assistance do not automatically require disclosure. Studio documents Attributes > AI use. The upload API supports status.containsSyntheticMedia.
evidence_to_design.design_inference: [INFERENCE] Whole-candidate approval must lock a human-reviewed AI-use disclosure decision alongside each scene's source type. A source-type change invalidates approval. API delivery sends status.containsSyntheticMedia and verifies the returned video's status through videos.list; Studio delivery confirms AI use and reads back its saved setting. A label inside the video is not a substitute for platform disclosure.

evidence_to_design.documented_fact: Commons extended metadata exposes author, credit and license fields but documents unreliable multi-license values; KOGL distinguishes commercial/derivative conditions by item license type.
evidence_to_design.design_inference: [INFERENCE] Present source authenticity, rights clearance and edit suitability as separate states; unknown rights block automatic use. Illustrative stock is not evidence of the actual reported event.

uncertainty_boundaries: No live competitor UI, mobile behavior, account access or accessibility compliance was tested.
Official documentation does not establish universal byte-bound approval or automatic invalidation in the compared tools.
Fusion macro live-update/pinning behavior and some product-specific channel/template semantics remain unestablished.
A downloadable file and machine-readable license are not a warranty of authenticity, complete rights clearance or suitability for a news claim.
No actual media import, paid generation, upload, public posting or channel ownership verification was performed.
next_interview_question: Does one production project represent one finished video/upload, or a recurring series containing several video episodes?
